decisions.choice: Alert dedupe uses notify()'s per-member dedupeKey 'notice:<noticeId>' rather than a new 'notified' column on notice_match
decisions.justification: No migration needed and a re-poll or replay cannot double-send; same approach as case-watch/alerts.ts:60-100 and bench-change.ts:387-395

decisions.choice: Holiday flag is a computed read in core/notices (not a stored column or a matter-graph change), keyed on effective_on of matched holiday notices
decisions.justification: Notices can arrive after listings, so a computed read never goes stale; matter-graph cannot import notices (core-domains.md); listing schema stays unchanged (docket.ts:50-97)
